title: Award Winning Audio Plugins
description: A collection of VST plugins developed for the AES MATLAB Hackathons, including a compressor, reverb, and a vocal processor.

title: hearsal
description: A collaborative setlist app that allows users to import chords and lyrics for a seamless practice environment.

title: Ravel
description: A RAVE-powered neural audio looper that turns your loops into something new.

title: dB Drifter
description: A chipeo inspired roguelite/driving game where sound literally powers your weapons and gear.

title: Boing
description: A spring-reverb plugin whose character comes from real fluid-loading physics.

title: jpegify
description: An image-based bit-crusher where the dropped-in image's JPEG data directly controls audio.

title: Nuker
description: A microwave-themed destruction effect: gamma-ray distortion, pumping compression, and cooking-appliance foley.

title: LoopRouter
description: A live looper VST/AU with a 4×8 send matrix and full OSC remote control.
